response.sql: SELECT AVG(avg_price) AS avg_of_invoice_mean_price, AVG(item_count) AS avg_line_items_per_invoice FROM (SELECT invoice_number, AVG(product_price) AS avg_price, COUNT(*) AS item_count FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number HAVING COUNT(product_price) > 0) AS t

assumptions.assumption: Both averages use the same set of invoices: those with at least one non-missing product_price. Invoices skipped for having no mean are also left out of the line-item average.
The line-item count includes all lines on an invoice, including those with a missing price. Invoices with no line items at all are not counted.

alternatives.interpretation: The line-item average covers every invoice that has at least one line item, including invoices skipped for the price mean. The price average still covers only invoices with a non-missing price.
alternatives.sql: SELECT (SELECT AVG(avg_price) FROM (SELECT AVG(product_price) AS avg_price FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number HAVING COUNT(product_price) > 0) AS a) AS avg_of_invoice_mean_price, (SELECT AVG(cnt) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number) AS b) AS avg_line_items_per_invoice
